fichas.title: Children’s daycare: types, access and building forms
fichas.summary: Overview of creches, kindergartens and after-school care, with functional arrangements, access types and building-form examples. The text recommends designing facilities for children’s needs and size, using relevant state regulations and the LBO as guidelines, and following accessibility building-design standards.
uses: Care for babies and children up to three years old
Kindergarten care from age three until children go to school
After-school care for school-age children until age 14
Lunch, sleep and homework assistance where offered
Organising group rooms, cloakrooms and sanitary facilities
